tools.name: ping_server
tools.title: Ping Dirt server
tools.description: Run a non-mutating end-to-end health check across the authenticated bridge, Dirt plugin, Paper, and a Paper-backed FAWE session. Returns only status ok on success.
tools.useWhen: Use this first when you need to confirm that the complete Dirt path is healthy.
tools.returns: A single ok status when every dependency responds.
tools.caution: This is a health check, not a detailed diagnostic report.

tools.name: get_server_status
tools.title: Get server status
tools.description: Return current builds and performance plus selected player, world, and configuration sections. Worlds default on; players and configuration default off.
tools.useWhen: Use this to discover loaded worlds and players or check the limits that constrain other calls.
tools.inputs: Choose whether to include players, worlds, and configuration; worlds are included by default.
tools.returns: Build and performance data plus only the selected detail sections.
tools.caution: Excluded sections are returned as null, and only loaded worlds can be used by other tools.

tools.name: count_region_block_states
tools.title: Count region block states
tools.description: Return a complete canonical block-state histogram for an inclusive region.
tools.useWhen: Use this when totals are enough and exact block positions would be unnecessary overhead.
tools.inputs: Provide a loaded world and two inclusive block corners in either order.
tools.returns: Normalized bounds, dimensions, volume, and a complete block-state histogram.
tools.caution: Air is included, and the scan fails rather than truncates when a server limit is exceeded.

tools.name: get_blocks
tools.title: Get blocks
tools.description: Return filtered exact block states as replay-ready palettes, placements, and cuboid runs.
tools.useWhen: Use this to inspect exact positions or copy a structure for a later set_blocks call.
tools.inputs: Provide a loaded world, inclusive bounds, optional state filters, whether to include air, and a result ceiling.
tools.returns: An origin, block-state palettes, singleton placements, and compact cuboid runs.
tools.caution: The call fails rather than returning a partial structure when its effective result limit is exceeded.

tools.name: scan_orthographic_view
tools.title: Scan an orthographic view
tools.description: Return a selected non-air depth on bounded world-axis sightlines as replay-ready block geometry.
tools.useWhen: Use this for a compact elevation or plan-like view without retrieving the entire volume.
tools.inputs: Provide a loaded world, anchor, one of six axis directions, horizontal and vertical radii, ray distance, depth, and a result ceiling.
tools.returns: Replay-ready block geometry for the selected visible layer.
tools.caution: This is a server-side block scan, not a rendered image with lighting, entities, or resource packs.

tools.name: get_player_context
tools.title: Get player context
tools.description: Capture an online player's position, orientation, pose, and selected optional state. Player names are matched exactly but case-insensitively; UUID selectors are also accepted.
tools.useWhen: Use this to anchor later inspection or camera work to what an online player is doing now.
tools.inputs: Select an online player by name or UUID and choose optional equipment, inventory, ender chest, vitals, movement, client, and effects sections.
tools.returns: The player's identity, world position, rotation, pose, and requested optional state.
tools.caution: The player must be online; names match exactly but case-insensitively.

tools.name: get_perspective_view
tools.title: Get perspective view
tools.description: Trace a grid of first block-collision hits from an online player's eye pose or a loaded-world camera position.
tools.useWhen: Use this to understand what is in front of a player or camera before planning an edit.
tools.inputs: Choose a player or explicit loaded-world camera, odd viewport dimensions, field of view, ray distance, fluid collision, and passable-block handling.
tools.returns: Camera metadata and a grid of hit or miss samples with canonical block states.
tools.caution: This describes server block collisions only; it is not the player's rendered client view.

tools.name: replace_region_blocks
tools.title: Replace region blocks
tools.description: Replace matching block states throughout an inclusive region. Supply a concise edit label; use dryRun to preview and reuse the returned seed to reproduce a palette choice.
tools.useWhen: Use this for broad material substitutions where matching states, rather than exact positions, define the edit.
tools.inputs: Provide a world, bounds, source patterns, destination palette, concise label, preview flag, and optional seed and change ceiling.
tools.returns: A preview, no-change result, or committed edit record with exact counts and a reproducible seed.
tools.caution: Preview first; committed changes enter bounded in-memory undo history and require loaded chunks.

tools.name: set_blocks
tools.title: Set blocks
tools.description: Place blocks from weighted palettes using origin-relative placements and cuboid runs. Supply a concise edit label; use dryRun to preview.
tools.useWhen: Use this for exact structures, sparse placements, or geometry previously returned by an inspection tool.
tools.inputs: Provide a world, origin, palettes, placements or runs, concise label, preview flag, and optional seed and change ceiling.
tools.returns: A preview, no-change result, or committed edit record with exact counts and a reproducible seed.
tools.caution: Preview first and keep geometry within loaded chunks; committed changes are retained only in bounded memory.

tools.name: get_edit_history
tools.title: Get edit history
tools.description: Return currently retained undoable Dirt edits for one loaded world, newest first.
tools.useWhen: Use this before undo or after an ambiguous mutation result to identify retained edit IDs and order.
tools.returns: Newest-first committed or recovery-required edit records and history capacity information.
tools.caution: History is bounded, in memory, world-specific, and cleared by unloads, shutdowns, or restarts.

tools.name: undo_edits
tools.title: Undo edits
tools.description: Undo a non-empty newest-first prefix of retained Dirt edits in one loaded world.
tools.useWhen: Use this after reading edit history and deciding which uninterrupted newest-first sequence to restore.
tools.inputs: Provide a loaded world and a non-empty newest-first list of retained edit IDs.
tools.returns: Completed undo records or a partial result that identifies where restoration stopped.
tools.caution: The requested IDs must be an exact newest-first prefix; undo can partially complete if a later restoration fails.

tools.name: run_minecraft_commands
tools.title: Run Minecraft commands
tools.description: Run Minecraft commands in order as an operator-level non-player sender. Execution stops at the first dispatch failure. Command effects are not atomic or undoable; after an ambiguous transport failure, inspect state before retrying.
tools.useWhen: Use this only when a bounded semantic Dirt tool cannot perform the required server action.
tools.inputs: Provide a non-empty ordered list of command strings without leading slashes.
tools.returns: Per-command dispatch status and bounded feedback until the first failure.
tools.caution: Effects are non-atomic, are outside Dirt undo, and may have completed after a timeout or disconnect.
